name: Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
description: Matter, SI units, significant figures, laws of combination, mole concept, empirical formula, stoichiometry and concentration terms

name: Chapter 2: Structure of Atom
description: Subatomic particles, Thomson and Rutherford models, EM radiation, photoelectric effect, Bohr model, de Broglie, uncertainty, quantum numbers, orbitals and configurations

name: Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
description: Triads to Mendeleev, modern periodic law, IUPAC names above 100, s p d f blocks, and trends in radius, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, electronegativity

name: Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
description: Lewis structures, formal charge, ionic bonds, bond parameters, resonance, dipole moment, VSEPR, hybridisation, MO theory, hydrogen bonds

name: Chapter 5: Thermodynamics
description: Systems, first law, work and heat, enthalpy, calorimetry, Hess’s law, bond and lattice enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs energy and equilibrium

name: Chapter 6: Equilibrium
description: Physical and chemical equilibria, Kc and Kp, Q, ΔG and K, Le Chatelier, acids and bases, pH, Ka and Kb, hydrolysis, buffers and Ksp

name: Chapter 7: Redox Reactions
description: Classical and electronic redox, oxidation number rules, types of redox reactions, balancing by two methods, redox titrations and electrode potentials

name: Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
description: Hybridisation, structural formulas, classification, IUPAC naming, isomerism, reaction intermediates, electronic effects, purification and analysis

name: Chapter 9: Hydrocarbons
description: Alkanes, conformations, alkenes, Markovnikov and peroxide effect, alkynes, benzene, aromaticity, electrophilic substitution, directive influence and carcinogenicity
